reasoning_traces.think:
The synthesis integrates five distinct coaching signals—drift, changepoints, aggression, situational splits, and 4th-down decision models—into a single modular framework. Each signal operates within its own regime but converges through shared temporal and contextual axes. Drift alarms detect deviations in EPA-margin dynamics using z^t embeddings; changepoint triggers fire when P(changepoint) exceeds a threshold; aggression thermometers map τ̂ across field regions and win probabilities. Situational layers like 2nd-&-1 splits provide granular decision fingerprints. The 4th-down module refines go4th_rate into τ̂ per half and WP bin, improving prediction fidelity. These primitives form a dualistic structure: one layer for static profiling (Monken), another for dynamic adaptation (drift/changepoint). Failure modes include data gaps in time-to-throw, lack of empirical grounding in raw metrics, and misalignment between pipeline outputs and real-world coaching behavior.
